title: Localize CompletedTaskItem's 'removed from history' message
description: Replace the hardcoded template literal with a resource-backed lookup using the task title as a format arg.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded string template is replaced by stringResource(R.string.remove_from_history_message, task.title)
start_anchor: message = "\"${task.title}\" will be permanently removed from your Loot Almanac history. This can't be undone.",
